newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia registers St Petersburg Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Russia registers St Petersburg Eurobond.

text.p: Russia's Finance Ministry has given the city of St Petersburg the final clearance necessary to issue a Eurobond of up to $300 million.
The Ministry has registered a prospectus for the city of St Petersburg for a Eurobond of up to $300 million, Prime-Tass news agency quoted a Finance Ministry official as saying.
The city has not said if it will issue a tranche of the bond, with a three- to five-year maturity, in the United States, which would require permission of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
Salomon Brothers will lead manage the issue and probably will organise a road-show for the bond.
Standard & Poor's and IBCA have both rated St Petersburg BB-.
